scope: Advisory review of externally obtained datasets; no adversarial safety certification

future_report_contract.source_manifest_sha256: Required before a report applies to a dataset
future_report_contract.per_sample_source_sha256: Required before a finding applies to an image
future_report_contract.reviewer_and_tool_revision: Required; keep automated and human decisions distinct
future_report_contract.output: Separate JSON report; never modify depth arrays or existing source files
future_report_contract.unknown_results: Remain visible and unresolved; do not silently mark them accepted
future_report_contract.network_access: Off by default; require an explicit choice before image upload
